silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked whether fully utilizing 110 hours is a hard constraint or a soft goal nor its priority; it silently fixed it as available capacity in the READY_TO_MODEL understanding.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the P0 slot H1 (nature/priority of the 110-hour utilization goal) was never clarified, silently enforcing it as fixed capacity.

summary: The agent properly probed the overtime-limit nature (H2) but never addressed the P0 question of whether the 110-hour full-utilization target is a hard constraint or a prioritized soft goal, instead silently treating it as fixed capacity before stopping.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
